title: ngrok AI Gateway translation matrix
description: What happens to each request field when the AI Gateway translates a request from one API to another. Generated by `nd gen docs` in the ngrok monorepo.

param.description: The dotted path of the lost part, as the removed parameters name it.

field.description: The request field, in the source API's spelling. Nested fields use dotted names.

case.description: Names the variant when one field has several rows. minimal marks a field the target writes on every request.

value.description: The value the client sends. On an added row, the value the target writes, or null when the value depends on the model, such as its output token limit. The note then says what the value is.

outcome.description: translated: the target carries the field. partial: the target carries the field but drops the parts that removed_parts lists. clamped: the target changes the value to one it accepts. removed: the target drops the field. refused: the gateway does not send the request to a model of the target API. added: the target writes a field the client did not send.

reason.description: Why the field was clamped or removed, or why a partial row lost its parts. format: the target API has no place for it. model: the target model refuses it with another setting. clamped: the value is outside the target's range. output_limit: the value shrank to fit the output token limit.

target_fields.description: The top-level fields of the target request that the field changes.

refused_fields.description: The fields that the target cannot carry, on a refused row.

removed_parts.description: The parts of the field that the target drops, on a partial row.
